stem: One ad platform exports daily spend in UTC, while Voltmarkt's other spend data uses Amsterdam time, which is 1 or 2 hours ahead of UTC. An analyst adds the two up by day without converting. What goes wrong?

options.text: Monthly totals stay right, because every day still has 24 hours in both time zones
Spend near midnight falls on another day, and at a month's end in another month
Clicks move to another day, but the spend stays on the day it was booked
Each day's spend is counted twice, once in each of the two time zones
